title: The Wedding Season Playbook
kicker: A practical guide for wedding planners, caterers, decorators and banquet halls
subtitle: How to answer every family's enquiry, send quotes you approve, collect advances on time and keep every vendor in sync during the wedding season.

overview.heading: The four automations at a glance
overview.intro: Each automation runs on its own, and they share one record per event. Start with the instant reply: in peak season, the first planner to answer usually gets the call.

rules.label: What makes it reliable
rules.heading: Three rules that keep it working

items.title: One record per event
items.text: Date, guests, package, payments and vendors live in one place, so nothing is copied by hand.

items.title: Clear rules
items.text: You decide what the AI may say, which dates it may offer and when it hands over to you.

items.title: You approve
items.text: Quotes, discounts and anything unusual come to you first. Every message is logged.

workflows.name: Reply to every enquiry
workflows.goal: Every family gets a warm, useful reply in minutes, even at night or in the middle of a function.
workflows.trigger: A new message on WhatsApp Business, an Instagram DM or your website form.
steps: Read the message: family name, date, guest count and what they want.
Check your calendar and reply with open dates and your packages.
Ask the next useful question: venue, events, budget.
Save the enquiry as a new event record and notify you.
tools: Google Sheets, Zoho CRM or HubSpot, with ChatGPT or Claude
workflows.approval: replies use only the packages, prices and dates you approved. Anything else comes to you.

workflows.name: Draft the quote
workflows.goal: Families get a clear quote quickly, and you still control every number.
workflows.trigger: The family has shared date, guest count and the services they need.
steps: Pick the matching package and add the requested services.
Draft the quote in your format with inclusions and terms.
Send it to you for approval, edits or a discount.
Send the approved quote to the family and set a follow-up.
tools: Google Docs, Canva or your quote template
ChatGPT or Claude, with your price list
workflows.approval: no quote reaches a family until you approve it.

workflows.name: Payment reminders
workflows.goal: Advances and balances arrive on time, without awkward calls.
workflows.trigger: An advance or balance is due within the days you set.
steps: Check upcoming due dates every morning.
Send a polite reminder from your approved template, with the payment link.
Mark the payment as received when it arrives.
Tell you about anything still pending after the due date.
workflows.approval: only the reminder templates you approved go out, and you handle anything sensitive personally.

workflows.name: Vendor updates
workflows.goal: Caterer, decorator, photographer and DJ always have the latest details.
workflows.trigger: A booking is confirmed or a detail changes: date, guest count, menu, timings.
steps: Detect the change in the event record.
Write a short update for each vendor it affects.
Send it to the vendor or the event's vendor group.
Collect confirmations and flag anyone who has not replied.
workflows.approval: you choose which changes go to which vendors, and big changes wait for you.
